frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Grid frequency throughout the Maldives is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: The primary electrical standard in the Maldives is the British three-pin rectangular Type G socket

advisory_headline.tr: Maldivler tatil adalarında ve atollerde güvenlik seviyesi en üst düzeydedir; olağan tedbirler yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Resort islands and tourist atolls are extremely safe; exercise normal travel precautions.

advisory_headline.es: Las islas resort y atolones son sumamente seguros; aplican precauciones normales.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in the Maldives reach approximately 56.4 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in the Maldives measure 42.1 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: All travelers must fill out the online IMUGA Traveler Declaration within 96 hours before arrival and departure. Dhiraagu and Ooredoo provide tourist 5G eSIMs with excellent coverage across private resorts and inhabited islands.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: IMUGA declaration is mandatory for all inbound and outbound international travelers

local_apps.name: IMUGA
local_apps.description: Official Maldives Immigration portal; mandatory digital entry declaration form required for all arrivals.

local_apps.name: Avas Ride
local_apps.description: Leading taxi hailing app for travel across Malé, Hulhumalé, and the Sinamalé Bridge to the airport.

local_apps.name: MyOoredoo / MyDhiraagu
local_apps.description: Official telecom apps for topping up data and managing tourist eSIM packages while on atoll transfers.

local_apps.name: FahiPay
local_apps.description: Popular Maldivian digital wallet and bill payment service.

tr.conditions: Tüm Türk vatandaşlarına havalimanında 30 günlük ücretsiz turist vizesi verilmektedir. Seyahatten 96 saat önce IMUGA formu doldurulmalıdır.

us.conditions: All foreign travelers including US citizens receive a free 30-day tourist visa on arrival with a confirmed resort/hotel booking and IMUGA form.

de.conditions: German citizens receive a free 30-day tourist visa on arrival upon showing hotel confirmation and completing the IMUGA form.

gb.conditions: British passport holders receive a 30-day tourist visa free of charge on arrival with a confirmed hotel reservation and IMUGA submission.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ въезжают на Мальдивы без визы на срок до 90 дней при наличии брони отеля и заполненной декларации IMUGA.

dos.title: Fill the IMUGA form within 96 hours
dos.description: Submitting the online IMUGA traveler declaration within 96 hours before flight departure is strictly checked at airline check-in.

dos.title: Respect local island dress codes
dos.description: On inhabited local islands (like Maafushi or Thulusdhoo), swimsuits are only allowed on designated 'Bikini Beaches'; dress modestly in villages.

dos.title: Use reef-safe sunscreen
dos.description: Maldives coral reefs are sensitive ecosystems; use certified mineral reef-safe sunscreens without oxybenzone.

donts.title: Don't bring alcohol into the Maldives
donts.description: Importing alcohol, pork products, or religious idols is strictly illegal; customs will confiscate any bottles found in luggage.

donts.title: Don't touch or step on living corals
donts.description: Corals are fragile living organisms; standing on them causes irreversible reef damage and carries strict resort penalties.

etiquette.tipping: Resorts and restaurants add a mandatory 10% service charge and 16% TGST (Tourism Goods and Services Tax); tipping extra to room attendants and boat crew is customary.
